name: Switchroom maintained-lighting control interface
aliases: switchrooms Switchroom lighting and access interfaces
summary: Separates the normal operating command from the emergency supply behavior of maintained lighting.
description: Separates the normal operating command from the emergency supply behavior of maintained lighting. Lighting and access interfaces coordinate the electrical-room service circuits and their supervision. Normal lighting, emergency illumination and access indication have different power sources and purposes.

In a switchroom, a normal lighting branch may be switched locally while the specified emergency luminaires remain connected to their own backed-up or integral supply. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Normal lighting control” at the input and “Maintained luminaire interface” at the output. The exact wiring follows the selected fitting.
